Subject: Demo timing — we ran into a DST snag

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for offering to run a product walkthrough next week. We have three primary stakeholders across NA, EMEA and APAC and at first glance your proposed window (Mar 11, 10:00–11:00 ET) looked good. Quick snag: our EMEA ops lead pointed out that the US switches to DST on Mar 9 while EU doesn't until Mar 30, so the usual one-hour overlaps are off for three weeks.

Can we confirm the exact UTC times so we don't end up with someone missing the start? Ideally we want 10–11 ET that day but if that shifts availability in London/Frankfurt we may need to slide an hour or offer a second, shorter session.

Attached is our internal availability matrix. Happy to be flexible.

Best,

Greenline Finance

Alex — thanks for flagging this, and good catch.

Quick note for clarity: Redwood's original slot (Mar 11, 10:00–11:00 ET) is 15:00–16:00 UTC on Mar 11. After the US moves clocks forward on Mar 9, ET becomes UTC-4. Europe will remain at UTC+1 until Mar 30, so that 10:00 ET slot still maps to 14:00 GMT for UK/IE — which may push into later afternoon for some EMEA folks.

Options we can offer (short list):
- Keep a single live session at 10:00 ET (15:00 UTC) and record the first 20 minutes for APAC viewers; follow with a 30-min bespoke APAC hour the following day.
- Shift live session to 09:00 ET (13:00 UTC) to better include EMEA morning but that makes a later start for APAC.
- Run two 45-minute region-focused sessions: EMEA-friendly and APAC-friendly (more ops overhead).

Marcus and Neha — tagging to confirm our team availability and whether we should propose two invites or a single confirm-with-recording plan. I've attached a one-page demo agenda and our NA invite (north-america-availability.ics) for the current slot.

Sofia
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf, north-america-availability.ics
